question.problem:
| ${x}_{1}$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$4$** | **$8$** | **$16$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${x}_{2}$ | **$2$** | **$4$** | **$6$** | **$8$** | **$10$** |
| ${x}_{3}$ | **$-10$** | **$-8$** | **$-5$** | **$-1$** | **$2$** |
| $y$ | $5$ | $10$ | $16$ | $22$ | $30$ |

The vector of coefficients of the hyperplane $y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}_{3}$ that best fits the data above can be found using multi linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?

The coefficients of the hyperplane 

$$
y={\beta }_{1}{x}_{1}+{\beta }_{2}{x}_{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}_{3}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -10 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 \\ 4 & 6 & -5 \\ 8 & 8 & -1 \\ 16 & 10 & 2\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 10 \\ 16 \\ 22 \\ 30\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
